purpose: Research menu for candidate actions. This file is not a simulation rule pack.

evidencePolicy.sourceFacts: Sources establish that an activity is used in campaigns. They do not establish a universal action duration, price, contact rate, or electoral effect.
evidencePolicy.unknowns: null minutes and dollars mean no defensible national value was found. They must not be read as zero.
evidencePolicy.jurisdiction: NDI manuals describe general campaign practice, including outside the United States. Federal FEC rules apply only where indicated. State and local compliance must be checked before implementation.
evidencePolicy.gameplay: Any later hours, cash costs, or effects are recommended gameplay calibration and require separate labeled data.

ndi-voter-contact.title: Campaign Skills Trainer's Guide, Module 4: Voter Contact
ndi-voter-contact.supports: Door canvassing, voter surveys, calls, literature, community meetings, festivals, social media, press, ads, and targeted get-out-the-vote contacts.

ndi-communications.title: Campaign Skills Trainer's Guide, Module 8: Building a Communications Strategy
ndi-communications.supports: Media events, press outreach, reporter interviews, and online communication.

ndi-planning.title: Campaign Skills Trainer's Guide, Module 9: Campaign Planning
ndi-planning.supports: Campaign schedules, volunteer recruitment, field roles, voter lists, and election-day deployment.

ndi-resources.title: Campaign Skills Trainer's Guide, Module 10: Mobilizing Resources
ndi-resources.supports: Identifying donors, asking for contributions, recruiting volunteers and in-kind support.

fec-in-kind.title: Making in-kind contributions to candidates
fec-in-kind.supports: Fundraising events, consulting, printing, mailing lists, and advertising can create reportable in-kind contributions.

fec-joint.title: Joint fundraising with other candidates and political committees
fec-joint.supports: Joint fundraisers require agreements, allocation, contribution screening, and reporting for federal committees.

fec-home.title: In-home event exemptions for candidates and parties
fec-home.supports: Volunteer-hosted home events are a real campaign setting; federal treatment depends on current rules.

lwv-forum.title: A Guide to Candidate Forums
lwv-forum.publisher: League of Women Voters of Virginia
lwv-forum.supports: Structured, neutral candidate forums with audience questions and speaking turns.

lwv-guide.title: VOTE411 voter guide
lwv-guide.publisher: League of Women Voters Education Fund
lwv-guide.supports: Candidate information and issue positions in voter guides.

fec-spending.title: Making disbursements
fec-spending.supports: Federal campaign spending categories include travel, staff, rent, advertising, fundraising, phones, and supplies.
